scope: experiments with labeled neighborhood representations and class centers; Q-only studies declare not_applicable

calculation.class_aggregation: equal class weight omega_c=1/K; means within each class then across classes
calculation.center_source: arithmetic mean of corresponding train representations, held fixed on validation
calculation.JS: entropy(mid) - .5*(entropy(p)+entropy(q)); sqrt means sqrt for each sample BEFORE mean
calculation.KL: D_KL(P||center); +Infinity if positive P mass unsupported by center, no hidden epsilon clipping in primary R
calculation.margin: normalized JS similarity of candidate hypothesis vs class-specific center; score true minus strongest rival
calculation.ties: argmax chooses lowest class index; report exact ties separately
calculation.uncertainty: separate independent seeds from repeated correlated rounds/parameter settings
calculation.test_split: no Test reuse for model selection

examples: Q TV error and sqrt-JSD to population; expected walk depth, runtime, target-realized JSD, training optimizer objective

artifact_standard.legacy: preserve original files in archive, link to original SHA, do not silently replace

status_conventions.measured: contains numeric value including observed zero
status_conventions.not_measured: necessary raw representations/labels not retained or not run
status_conventions.not_verified: historical number not recomputed against current contract
